ontology_label: Enterprise L2 Fiber Assurance & Network Inventory Ontology
ontology_comment: Conceptual semantic model aligning Enterprise Layer 2 Carrier Ethernet customer service inventory, optical transport topology, and automated trouble triage with TM Forum SID GB922 and eTOM GB921 business processes.

etom_processes.label: eTOM 1.3.7 Problem Handling
etom_processes.comment: Customer-facing service problem reception, SLA triage, root-cause correlation, and customer status notification.

etom_processes.label: eTOM 1.4.5 Resource Trouble Management
etom_processes.comment: Network resource fault localization, optical transceiver DDM diagnostics, autonomous self-healing, and field technician dispatch.

proposed_classes.label: Customer
proposed_classes.comment: An enterprise party or organization that subscribes to commercial telecom products and holds an active Master Service Agreement.

proposed_classes.label: Product
proposed_classes.comment: A procured commercial telecom offering binding a customer agreement to one or more CustomerFacingServices.

proposed_classes.label: Customer Facing Service
proposed_classes.comment: An active Layer 2 Ethernet or wavelength connectivity circuit directly visible to and contracted by an enterprise customer.

proposed_classes.label: Service Specification
proposed_classes.comment: Standardized commercial catalog SKU defining bandwidth tier, SLA packet-loss ceiling, availability target, and autonomous remediation eligibility.

proposed_classes.label: Resource Facing Service
proposed_classes.comment: Internal network transport and access bearer service realizing a CustomerFacingService across PE routers, OLT ports, fiber spans, and CPE devices.

proposed_classes.label: Physical Resource
proposed_classes.comment: A physical network equipment asset deployed in the provider core, access plant, or customer demarcation point.

proposed_classes.label: OLT Optical Port Resource
proposed_classes.comment: Optical Line Terminal transceiver port terminating the access fiber span and providing real-time gNMI DDM optical telemetry.

proposed_classes.label: Customer Premises Equipment Resource
proposed_classes.comment: Physical demarcation switch or router installed at the enterprise customer site.

proposed_classes.label: Provider Edge Router Resource
proposed_classes.comment: Metro or core Provider Edge router aggregating L2 Ethernet access bearers.

proposed_classes.label: Physical Resource Specification
proposed_classes.comment: Vendor equipment model specification defining hardware capabilities, supported optical transceivers, and DDM calibration thresholds.

proposed_classes.label: Trouble Ticket
proposed_classes.comment: TMF621 operational assurance ticket tracking network incidents, automated remediations, or field fiber splicing dispatches.

proposed_classes.label: Service Level Agreement Clause
proposed_classes.comment: Contractual or catalog SLA clause specifying packet-loss thresholds, mean time to repair, service credit penalties, and VIP escalation rules.

proposed_classes.label: Optical Calibration Profile
proposed_classes.comment: Vendor hardware manual optical Digital Diagnostic Monitoring power envelope and autonomous laser bias recalibration specification.

proposed_classes.label: Business Process
proposed_classes.comment: An operational activity defined within the TM Forum eTOM business process framework governing service assurance and resource triage.

proposed_properties.label: has customer
proposed_properties.comment: Associates an active Customer Facing Service with the contracted enterprise subscriber.

proposed_properties.label: is described by
proposed_properties.comment: Associates a Customer Facing Service instance with its commercial service specification catalog tier.

proposed_properties.label: supports service
proposed_properties.comment: Links an underlying Resource Facing Service transport bearer to the Customer Facing Service circuit it realizes.

proposed_properties.label: uses OLT port
proposed_properties.comment: Identifies the physical Optical Line Terminal transceiver port providing access connectivity for the resource service.

proposed_properties.label: terminates on router
proposed_properties.comment: Identifies the Provider Edge aggregation router hosting the L2 circuit endpoint.

proposed_properties.label: demarcates at CPE
proposed_properties.comment: Identifies the Customer Premises Equipment device serving as the on-site network demarcation endpoint.

proposed_properties.label: has resource specification
proposed_properties.comment: Links a physical hardware asset to its vendor model hardware specification.

proposed_properties.label: has optical calibration profile
proposed_properties.comment: Associates an equipment model specification with its vendor DDM optical power thresholds and recalibration limits.

proposed_properties.label: has SLA clause
proposed_properties.comment: Associates a commercial service specification tier with contractually binding SLA guarantees and penalty clauses.

proposed_properties.label: recommended upgrade specification
proposed_properties.comment: Points to the next tier commercial service specification recommended when bandwidth or packet loss thresholds are exceeded.

proposed_properties.label: affected circuit
proposed_properties.comment: References the Customer Facing Service circuit impacted by an assurance incident.

proposed_properties.label: affected resource
proposed_properties.comment: References the physical network resource identified as the root cause of an assurance fault.

proposed_properties.label: customer identifier
proposed_properties.comment: Canonical business identifier for an enterprise customer account.

proposed_properties.label: party legal name
proposed_properties.comment: Officially registered legal entity name of the enterprise customer.

proposed_properties.label: market segment
proposed_properties.comment: Commercial market classification tier such as enterprise VIP or public sector.

proposed_properties.label: account manager code
proposed_properties.comment: Unique employee or desk identifier of the designated enterprise account manager.

proposed_properties.label: chamber of commerce registration
proposed_properties.comment: Official commercial trade registry or chamber of commerce number for the enterprise.

proposed_properties.label: service identifier
proposed_properties.comment: Unique telecom circuit reference code assigned to a customer-facing service.

proposed_properties.label: operational status
proposed_properties.comment: Normalized lifecycle state of the connectivity service, such as ACTIVE or MAINTENANCE.

proposed_properties.label: bandwidth in gigabits per second
proposed_properties.comment: Contracted symmetrical bandwidth normalized to Gigabits per second.

proposed_properties.label: installation date
proposed_properties.comment: Calendar date when the customer connectivity circuit was physically handed over and activated.

proposed_properties.label: resource facing service identifier
proposed_properties.comment: Internal system identifier for the underlying network transport bearer.

proposed_properties.label: VLAN tag
proposed_properties.comment: IEEE 802.1Q Ethernet encapsulation identifier assigned to the Layer 2 bearer.

proposed_properties.label: fiber span identifier
proposed_properties.comment: Outside plant optical fiber segment identifier connecting the OLT to the customer premises.

proposed_properties.label: resource identifier
proposed_properties.comment: Unique hardware inventory asset tag or management identifier.

proposed_properties.label: resource name
proposed_properties.comment: DNS hostname or network management label for the physical hardware asset.

proposed_properties.label: port identifier
proposed_properties.comment: Physical port name or slot designation on an optical network device.

proposed_properties.label: SKU code
proposed_properties.comment: Commercial catalog product code identifying the service level tier.

proposed_properties.label: maximum packet loss percentage
proposed_properties.comment: Contractual frame loss ratio ceiling allowed before SLA violation occurs.

proposed_properties.label: availability target percentage
proposed_properties.comment: Annual uptime percentage guaranteed under the commercial service tier.

proposed_properties.label: lifecycle status
proposed_properties.comment: Catalog publication state of the service specification such as ACTIVE or DEPRECATED.

proposed_properties.label: auto-remediation allowed
proposed_properties.comment: Indicates whether autonomous optical recalibration is legally and technically permitted.

proposed_properties.label: minimum Rx optical power in dBm
proposed_properties.comment: Minimum acceptable optical receive power level in dBm before soft attenuation alerts trigger.

proposed_properties.label: loss of signal threshold in dBm
proposed_properties.comment: Optical power level in dBm indicating a physical fiber break and complete loss of signal.

proposed_properties.label: ticket identifier
proposed_properties.comment: Unique reference number assigned to an operational trouble ticket.

proposed_properties.label: severity
proposed_properties.comment: Impact severity classification of the assurance incident such as CRITICAL or MAJOR.

proposed_properties.label: status
proposed_properties.comment: Operational resolution state of the trouble ticket such as OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, or RESOLVED.

Customer reference on billing invoice record is out of scope for network assurance.
Billing cycle code is out of scope for network fault triage.
Financial billing gross monetary amount is out of scope for network assurance.
Tax regime identifier is out of scope for network assurance.
Value added tax percentage is out of scope for network assurance.
General ledger posting timestamp is out of scope for network assurance.
Customer dunning credit risk level is out of scope for network assurance.
The column ERP_BATCH_REF represents batch audit metadata and is excluded from the virtual graph.
The column AUDIT_HASH represents cryptographic hash audit metadata and is excluded from the virtual graph.

table_mappings.r2rml_label: Mapping for Enterprise Customer Party Records
table_mappings.sql_query: SELECT CUST_EXT_REF, LEGAL_NAME, SEGMENT_CD, ACCT_MGR_ID FROM T_OSS_CUST_PARTY

columns.audit_rationale: Internal database surrogate key has no business meaning in the TMF SID conceptual model.
Canonical customer account reference mapped to tmf:customerId and used as URI template key.
Corporate legal entity name mapped to tmf:partyLegalName.
Market segment classification mapped to tmf:marketSegment.
Assigned enterprise account manager code mapped to telco:accountManagerCode.
Legacy CRM foreign key is deprecated and excluded from the enterprise semantic model.
Physical database record creation timestamp is excluded to prevent internal plumbing leakage.

table_mappings.r2rml_label: Mapping for Active Customer Facing Service Circuits
table_mappings.sql_query: /* SCD2 Filter: Select active CFS rows (WHERE VALID_TO_TS IS NULL). Note: for circuit CIR-994821, expired row CFS_ROW_ID=2000 is filtered out and active row CFS_ROW_ID=2001 is retained */ SELECT CIRCUIT_ID, CUST_REF_ID, PROD_SPEC_CODE, INSTALL_DT, CASE OPER_STATUS_CD WHEN '10' THEN 'ACTIVE' WHEN '20' THEN 'MAINTENANCE' WHEN '99' THEN 'DECOMMISSIONED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS CANONICAL_OPER_STATUS, CASE BW_UNIT_CD WHEN 'Gbps' THEN CAST(BW_VAL AS REAL) WHEN 'Mbps' THEN CAST(BW_VAL AS REAL) / 1000.0 WHEN 'Kbps' THEN CAST(BW_VAL AS REAL) / 1000000.0 ELSE CAST(BW_VAL AS REAL) END AS BANDWIDTH_GBPS FROM T_CMDB_CFS_CIRCUIT WHERE VALID_TO_TS IS NULL

columns.audit_rationale: Physical SCD Type 2 surrogate primary key used for temporal versioning control only.
Business key for the connectivity circuit mapped to tmf:serviceId and used as subject template.
Foreign key linking the circuit to the enterprise customer URI via tmf:hasCustomer.
Commercial product catalog code linking the circuit to its service specification via tmf:isDescribedBy.
Legacy numeric status code translated into canonical operational status literals in SQL.
Raw numerical bandwidth value normalized to Gbps using BW_UNIT_CD in SQL pushdown.
Bandwidth unit code used for normalization calculation to unit:GigaBIT-PER-SEC.
Handover installation date mapped to telco:installationDate with xsd:date datatype.
SCD Type 2 record effective start timestamp used strictly for physical temporal control.
SCD Type 2 expiration timestamp used in R2RML WHERE VALID_TO_TS IS NULL to select active inventory.
Obsolete billing system routing tag excluded from the enterprise assurance ontology.

table_mappings.r2rml_label: Mapping for Resource Facing Service and Physical Topology
table_mappings.sql_query: SELECT RFS_ID, PARENT_CFS_ID, PE_ROUTER_HOSTNAME, OLT_PORT_ID, CPE_ASSET_ID, CPE_MODEL_SKU, VLAN_TAG, FIBER_SPAN_ID FROM T_CMDB_RFS_RESOURCE

columns.audit_rationale: Primary identifier for the Resource Facing Service mapped to tmf:rfsId.
Reference to realizing Customer Facing Service mapped via tmf:supportsService.
Provider Edge router hostname mapped to telco:terminatesOnRouter.
Optical Line Terminal port mapped to telco:usesOltPort.
Customer Premises Equipment asset identifier mapped to telco:demarcatesAtCpe.
Vendor hardware model SKU linking the CPE device to its resource specification.
L2 transport encapsulation VLAN tag mapped to telco:vlanTag.
Physical outside plant fiber span identifier mapped to telco:fiberSpanId.
Network management system polling synchronization timestamp excluded from conceptual ontology.

shacl_shapes.label: Service Specification SHACL Validation Shape
shacl_shapes.comment: Enforces required catalog SKU code, valid packet loss and availability percentages, and lifecycle status.

property_constraints.message: A ServiceSpecification must have exactly one string SKU code.
A ServiceSpecification must define maximum packet loss percentage between 0.0 and 100.0.
A ServiceSpecification must define availability target percentage between 0.0 and 100.0.
A ServiceSpecification must have lifecycle status of either ACTIVE or DEPRECATED.

shacl_shapes.label: Trouble Ticket SHACL Validation Shape
shacl_shapes.comment: Validates operational assurance trouble tickets created for optical triage and field dispatches.

property_constraints.message: A TroubleTicket must have exactly one string ticket identifier.
TroubleTicket severity must be one of CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR, or WARNING.
A TroubleTicket must specify its current operational workflow status.
A TroubleTicket must reference at least one affected CustomerFacingService circuit IRI.
A TroubleTicket must reference at least one affected physical network resource IRI.

architect_verification_questions: Does the Lead Ontologist approve the retention of exactly 14 TM Forum SID and telecom domain classes, confirming that financial billing and marketing classes are strictly pruned from the operational assurance TBox?

Does the Lead Architect approve excluding T_BILLING_AUDIT_NOISE and stripping internal surrogate keys, legacy CRM identifiers, and NMS synchronization watermarks to prevent physical database plumbing leakage into the Knowledge Graph?

Is the R2RML SQL pushdown filter WHERE VALID_TO_TS IS NULL confirmed as the authoritative mechanism to resolve active SCD Type 2 circuit state (such as retaining row 2001 and suppressing expired row 2000 for circuit CIR-994821)?

Does the Lead Architect validate the status mapping rules (10 to ACTIVE, 20 to MAINTENANCE, 99 to DECOMMISSIONED) and the QUDT conversion arithmetic transforming mixed Kbps, Mbps, and Gbps values into canonical Gigabits per second?
